Quiz.title: Quick knowledge check
Quiz.intro: 5 short questions — optional, and never scored against you.
Quiz.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Quiz.day30BannerBody: Take a 5-question knowledge check — it takes about a minute.

q1.text: [CLINICAL REVIEW REQUIRED] How long does a typical menstrual cycle usually last?
options: 21 to 35 days
Exactly 28 days, always
60 to 90 days
It's always irregular, so it's not worth tracking

q2.text: [CLINICAL REVIEW REQUIRED] Which of these is a sign you should see a clinician soon?
options: Mild cramping on the first day
Pain that repeatedly stops you going to school or work
Feeling a bit tired during your period
A period starting a few days earlier than expected

q3.text: [CLINICAL REVIEW REQUIRED] What generally counts as heavy bleeding?
options: Soaking a pad or tampon faster than about every 1-2 hours
Any bleeding at all
Bleeding for exactly 5 days
Spotting between periods only

q4.text: [CLINICAL REVIEW REQUIRED] If you have sudden, severe pelvic pain or feel like you might faint, what should you do?
options: Wait a few days to see if it passes
Seek urgent medical care right away
Only log it in the app for later
Nothing — this is always normal

q5.text: [CLINICAL REVIEW REQUIRED] Can you get pregnant during your period?
options: No, never
Pregnancy risk is lower but not zero at any point in the cycle
Only on the very last day
Only if you've been pregnant before
